name: Oxyprothepin decanoate
summary: Oxyprothepin decanoate, sold under the brand name Meclopin, is a typical antipsychotic which was used in the treatment of schizophrenia in the Czech Republic but is no longer marketed. It is administered by depot injection into muscle. The medication has an approximate duration of 2 to 3 weeks. The history of oxyprothepin decanoate has been reviewed.

uses.text: Oxyprothepin decanoate, sold under the brand name Meclopin, is a typical antipsychotic which was used in the treatment of schizophrenia in the Czech Republic but is no longer marketed.

pharmacology.en: Like other typical antipsychotics it blocks dopamine D2 receptors. The ester form is broken down in the body to release the active drug.
pharmacology.zh: 與其他典型抗精神病藥一樣，它阻斷多巴胺 D2 受體。酯類形式會在體內被分解，釋放出有活性的藥物。
pharmacology.zhHans: 与其他典型抗精神病药一样，它阻断多巴胺 D2 受体。酯类形式会在体内被分解，释放出有活性的药物。

sideEffects.en: Typical antipsychotics commonly cause stiffness, tremor and restlessness, and long-term use can cause tardive dyskinesia, which is lasting involuntary movements. A long-acting injection cannot be withdrawn quickly if problems appear.
sideEffects.zh: 典型抗精神病藥常造成肌肉僵硬、顫抖與躁動不安，長期使用可能導致遲發性運動障礙，也就是持久的不自主動作。長效注射劑若出現問題，無法迅速撤除。
sideEffects.zhHans: 典型抗精神病药常造成肌肉僵硬、颤抖与躁动不安，长期使用可能导致迟发性运动障碍，也就是持久的不自主动作。长效注射剂若出现问题，无法迅速撤除。

fact.en: The decanoate part is a ten-carbon fatty acid chain attached to the drug. Injected into muscle, this oily ester releases the medicine slowly, so one injection lasts for weeks.
fact.zh: 「癸酸酯」是接在藥物上的十碳脂肪酸鏈。注射到肌肉後，這種油性酯類會緩慢釋放藥物，因此一次注射可維持數週。
fact.zhHans: 「癸酸酯」是接在药物上的十碳脂肪酸链。注射到肌肉后，这种油性酯类会缓慢释放药物，因此一次注射可维持数周。
